Scar Memory.name: Scar Memory
Scar Memory.description: The user calls on bodily memory to grow one adaptation they have survived and trained many times before, such as plated hide, blister-proof skin, gill slits, insulation or dark-adapted eyes, in one breath without taking exposure first, and holds up to three adaptations at once this scene. It fades after ten minutes, never forms untried traits, and blocks new shifts until their next turn. Strain: severe.
